generalLedger.empty: Select an account and period, then run the report.
generalLedger.summary: {code} · {name} · {period} · {currency}. Posted entries only, including memos and reversals. Each row shows the account movement within one journal.
generalLedger.cashBookNote: Transfers appear as payments in the sending account and receipts in the receiving account. Credit closing balances are shown as Cr.

journalRegister.empty: Select a reporting period and run the report. Expand a journal to see its debit and credit accounts.
journalRegister.summary: Posted entries · {period} · {currency} · {status}. Reversal links include entries outside this period. Posting times are shown in your local time; CSV timestamps are UTC.
journalRegister.unbalanced: An unbalanced journal was found. Review its debit and credit lines.

profitAndLoss.loadError: Unable to load profit and loss
profitAndLoss.empty: Select a reporting period and run the report.
profitAndLoss.summary: {period} · {currency} · {mode}. Posted revenue and expenses, including memo adjustments and reversals. Drafts and unposted operational costs are excluded.
profitAndLoss.modeDefault: Accounting base translated to the default transaction currency at the report-date rate

customerStatement.empty: Select a customer and reporting period.
customerStatement.conversionNote: Customer-currency equivalent using the rate valid on {date}
customerStatement.alertDescription: Includes linked invoices, receipts, memos, reversals and customer advances. A debit balance is due from the customer; a credit balance is in their favour. The net balance includes unallocated advances. Manual journals without a customer link are excluded.

vendorStatement.empty: Select a vendor and reporting period.
vendorStatement.conversionNote: Vendor-currency equivalent using the rate valid on {date}
vendorStatement.alertDescription: Includes posted bills, allocated payments, memos and reversals. A credit balance is payable to the vendor; a debit balance is in your favour. Direct expenses paid without a bill allocation and manual journals without a vendor link are excluded.

currencyExposure.alertDescription: Exposure includes outstanding posted foreign invoices and bills as of the end date. Cash/bank holdings, advances and unlinked manual balances are excluded. Estimated revaluation uses the rate valid at that date and does not post accounting entries. Positive differences are gains; negative differences are losses. Posted movements below include accounts 4200-FX and 5500 (including rounding, manual and closing entries); the currency filter uses journal currency.

receivableAging.alertTitle: Outstanding posted invoices, aged by due date
receivableAging.alertDescription: Includes only postings effective by the as-of date, with payments, memo adjustments and reversals applied historically. Invoices due on that date are not overdue. Unallocated advances and unlinked manual journals are excluded. Customer currency uses the rate valid at the as-of date; totals remain separate for each currency.

payableAging.alertTitle: Outstanding posted bills, aged by due date
payableAging.alertDescription: Includes only postings effective by the as-of date, with payments, memo adjustments and reversals applied historically. Bills due on that date are not overdue. Direct expenses paid without a bill allocation and unlinked manual journals are excluded. Vendor currency uses the rate valid at the as-of date; totals remain separate for each currency.

invoiceRegister.alertTitle: Invoice dates with current settlement status
invoiceRegister.alertDescription: Balances include all currently posted payments and memos, including those after the selected invoice period. Draft and voided amounts are shown separately and have no receivable balance. Customer currency uses the rate valid at the period end. Expand an invoice to view its charges.

billRegister.alertTitle: Bill dates with current settlement status
billRegister.alertDescription: Balances include all currently posted payments and memos, including those after the selected bill period. Draft and voided amounts are shown separately and have no payable balance. Vendor currency uses the rate valid at the period end. Expand a bill to view its charges.

receiptRegister.alertTitle: Receipt dates with current posting status
receiptRegister.alertDescription: Includes receipt vouchers and operation receipts, including unallocated customer advances. Allocated operation receipts appear once. Draft and voided totals are separate from posted receipts. Allocations are shown in both invoice and receipt currencies. Customer currency uses the period-end rate.

paymentVoucherRegister.alertTitle: Payment dates with current posting status
paymentVoucherRegister.alertDescription: Includes payment vouchers and operation payments, including direct expenses paid without bill allocations. Allocated operation payments appear once. Draft and voided totals are separate from posted payments. Allocations are shown in both bill and payment currencies. Vendor currency uses the period-end rate.

creditMemoRegister.alertTitle: Credit memo dates with current posting status
creditMemoRegister.alertDescription: Customer credits reduce receivables; vendor credits reduce payables. Totals are separated by party type, currency and status. Draft and voided memos do not represent active posted credits. Party currency uses the period-end rate.
creditMemoRegister.totalsTitle: Totals by currency, party type and status

debitMemoRegister.alertTitle: Debit memo dates with current posting status
debitMemoRegister.alertDescription: Customer debits increase receivables; vendor debits increase payables. Totals are separated by party type, currency and status. Draft and voided memos do not represent active posted debits. Party currency uses the period-end rate.
debitMemoRegister.totalsTitle: Totals by currency, party type and status

outstandingCustomers.alertTitle: Customer balances from outstanding posted invoices
outstandingCustomers.alertDescription: Includes only postings effective by the as-of date, with payments, memo adjustments and reversals applied historically. Invoices due on that date are not overdue. Unallocated advances and unlinked manual journals are excluded. Customer currency uses the rate valid at the as-of date; totals remain separate for each currency.

outstandingVendors.alertTitle: Vendor balances from outstanding posted bills
outstandingVendors.alertDescription: Includes only postings effective by the as-of date, with payments, memo adjustments and reversals applied historically. Bills due on that date are not overdue. Direct expenses without bill allocations and unlinked manual journals are excluded. Vendor currency uses the rate valid at the as-of date; totals remain separate for each currency.

customerAdvances.alertTitle: Posted customer advances as of the selected date
customerAdvances.alertDescription: Shows unallocated receipts posted to customer advances (account 2100). Draft receipts and receipts allocated directly to invoices are excluded. Reversals effective by the selected date are excluded. Unlinked manual journals are excluded; this report does not allocate or refund advances. Customer currency uses the as-of rate.

expenseAnalysis.alertDescription: Net expense is debit less credit, including memos, reversals, manual journals and closing entries posted in the period. Draft charges and bills are excluded. Inactive accounts with history remain visible. Base currency uses saved historical journal values.

revenueAnalysis.alertDescription: Net revenue is credit less debit, including memos, reversals, manual journals and closing entries posted in the period. Draft charges and invoices are excluded. Inactive accounts with history remain visible. Base currency uses saved historical journal values.

operationProfitability.alertTitle: Posted operation revenue less posted operation costs
operationProfitability.alertDescription: Uses charge-level operation links, memo adjustments, reversals and direct expenses paid. Invoice/bill settlements are not counted again. Draft charges, unposted labour/material estimates, customer advances, standalone documents, unlinked manual journals, overhead and settlement exchange differences are excluded. This is operation contribution profit, not company net profit. Dates are posting dates; base amounts use saved exchange values.

taxSummary.alertDescription: Opening balance, posted debits and credits, and closing balance. A credit balance is a tax liability. Invoice and bill tax codes, rates, taxable amounts and input/output tax classifications are not recorded yet, so this is not a tax return. Debits are not automatically input tax and credits are not automatically output tax. Custom tax accounts are not included.
taxSummary.selectPrompt: Select an account and period, then run the report.
taxSummary.postedEntriesNote: Posted entries only, including memos and reversals. Each row shows the account movement within one journal.
taxSummary.cashBookNote: Transfers appear as payments in the sending account and receipts in the receiving account. Credit closing balances are shown as Cr.

postingAudit.alertDescription: Filters use accounting posting dates. Posting timestamps identify when entries were recorded. User IDs are immutable audit identifiers. Reversed status and original/reversal links reflect current history, including entries outside the selected period. Draft changes, failed posting attempts and unposted cancellations are excluded.
postingAudit.selectPrompt: Select a reporting period and run the report. Expand a journal to see its debit and credit accounts.
postingAudit.summary: Posted entries · {period} · {currency} · {status}. Reversal links include entries outside this period. Posting times are shown in your local time; CSV timestamps are UTC.
postingAudit.unbalanced: An unbalanced journal was found. Review its debit and credit lines.

employeeExpenses.runToLoadEmployees: Run the report to load employees
employeeExpenses.alertTitle: Expenses paid by each employee, from every module
employeeExpenses.alertDescription: Survey, pickup, packing and delivery expenses with a “Paid by” employee, by expense date. Includes expenses still waiting in the accountant's posting queue, so the pending amount is what has not reached the ledger yet. Expenses with no “Paid by” are not listed.
employeeExpenses.missingValues_one: {count} expense has no saved exchange rate and shows no converted amount.
employeeExpenses.missingValues_other: {count} expenses have no saved exchange rate and show no converted amount.
employeeExpenses.emptyText: No employee expenses in this period

page.title: Accounting reports
page.intro: Select a report. It opens on its own page with its filters, print and export.

descriptions.trialBalance: Opening, period and closing balances of every account; checks that debits equal credits.
descriptions.generalLedger: Every posted entry per account with running balance.
descriptions.journalRegister: All posted journal entries in date order, with their lines.
descriptions.profitAndLoss: Income and expenses for the period and the resulting profit.
descriptions.balanceSheet: Assets, liabilities and equity at a date.
descriptions.cashFlow: Cash in and out by activity for the period.
descriptions.cashBook: Movements and balances of cash and bank accounts.
descriptions.customerStatement: Invoices, receipts and balance of one customer.
descriptions.vendorStatement: Bills, payments and balance of one vendor.
descriptions.receivableAging: Unpaid customer invoices by age bucket.
descriptions.payableAging: Unpaid vendor bills by age bucket.
descriptions.invoiceRegister: All customer invoices in the period.
descriptions.billRegister: All vendor bills in the period.
descriptions.receiptRegister: Customer receipts recorded in the period.
descriptions.paymentVoucherRegister: Payments made to vendors in the period.
descriptions.outstandingVendors: What is still owed to each vendor.
descriptions.customerAdvances: Advances received from customers and how much is left.
descriptions.expenseAnalysis: Expenses by account for the period.
descriptions.revenueAnalysis: Revenue by account for the period.
descriptions.operationProfitability: Income and costs per pickup, packing, delivery, warehouse or job.
descriptions.currencyExposure: Balances by currency and realised exchange differences.
descriptions.taxSummary: Tax collected and paid, by tax code.
descriptions.postingAudit: Postings and reversals with who did them and when.
descriptions.employeeExpenses: What each employee paid on surveys, pickups, packing and deliveries, posted or pending.

trialBalance.summary: Posted entries only · {from} to {to} · {currency}. Includes reversals and posted memos. Currency selection shows either consolidated base values or entries recorded in that transaction currency.
trialBalance.notBalanced: Trial balance is not balanced. Review the journal entries.

balanceSheet.selectDate: Select an as-of date and run the report.
balanceSheet.summary: As of {date} · {currency} · {mode}. Includes all posted entries through this date, including memos and reversals. Drafts are excluded.
balanceSheet.modeDefault: Accounting base translated to the default transaction currency at the report-date rate
balanceSheet.earningsNote: Accumulated earnings include revenue and expense balances not yet closed to equity. Amounts already transferred to equity are included in their equity accounts.

cashFlow.mappingSaved: Mapping saved. Run the report again.
cashFlow.runHint: Run the report to see posted cash and bank movements.
cashFlow.runHintDescription: Classification uses the counterpart account mappings. Unclassified or mixed activities need review. Cash transfers are excluded from activity totals.
cashFlow.summary: {from} to {to} · {currency}. Includes accounts marked Cash / bank in the chart of accounts, posted entries and reversals. A transaction-currency view includes only journals in that currency.
cashFlow.needsReviewDescription: Cash balances reconcile independently of classification. Assign account classifications; split journals containing multiple activity categories before treating the classification as complete.
cashFlow.mapDescription: Mappings apply when running reports, including historical periods. Cash and bank accounts are maintained in the chart of accounts. Opening funding and custom assets/liabilities remain unclassified until reviewed.

currencyReport.title: Financial currency report
currencyReport.description: Base values use saved transaction rates. Party-currency values convert those base amounts using the rate effective on the selected conversion date. Missing historical rates are shown explicitly; currencies are never added together.
